answer: Neighbor-quorum stops bulk fakes. A new identity claims a dune plot and needs seven established neighbors to countersign at 20 each. Endorsements file in the atlas registry; one cluster counts once. A saffron seal binds each signature to its key; a missed pulse voids the endorsement and burns 10. Forging 1,000 identities needs 7,000 signatures: 140,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented signatures burn the lender's stake. Honest identities pay 140 once.
